description: This Java class implements a servlet filter (CatalogUrlFilter) for handling URL rewriting and routing in an e-commerce catalog context within the OFBiz framework. It processes URL paths to identify product or category identifiers, constructs appropriate internal URLs, manages breadcrumb trails, and forwards requests accordingly.

classes.name: CatalogUrlFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that processes incoming URL requests to identify product or category URLs, constructs internal URLs, manages breadcrumb trails, and forwards requests accordingly within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main method that intercepts HTTP requests, parses URL paths, retrieves product/category info from the database, constructs internal URLs, manages breadcrumb trails, and forwards requests.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Performs cleanup when the filter is destroyed (empty implementation).

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Constructs a category URL based on request parameters and category data, either from an alternative URL or by generating a URL from the category trail.

methods.name: makeCategoryUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method that builds a category URL using detailed parameters, including trail, product/category IDs, view options, and search string.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Constructs a product URL based on request parameters and product data, either from an alternative URL or by generating a URL from the trail.

methods.name: makeProductUrl
methods.description: Overloaded method that builds a product URL using detailed parameters, including trail, product ID, and context path.

methods.name: getDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Returns the default locale string used for URL processing.

methods.name: setDefaultLocaleString
methods.description: Sets the default locale string used for URL processing.
